main.title: 시총 왕좌 등극한 SK하닉…증시 주도주, 전력·통신·전자 거쳐 AI 반도체로
main.body:
SK Hynix has ascended to the top market capitalization position on KOSPI, marking a significant shift in Korea's stock market leadership after 25 years of Samsung Electronics' dominance.

On June 22, SK Hynix closed at 2,919,000 won, up 5.61%, achieving a market capitalization of 208.04 trillion won, surpassing Samsung Electronics' 206.66 trillion won. This represents the first time in over two decades that the top position has changed hands.

SK Hynix's stock has surged 348% this year, substantially outpacing Samsung Electronics' 195% gain. Analysts attribute this to high concentration in memory semiconductors, particularly HBM (high bandwidth memory), as opposed to Samsung's diversified portfolio across smartphones, appliances, and displays.

The shift reflects the symbolization of AI semiconductors becoming the new central axis of domestic markets, according to securities analysts. Historical context shows KOSPI leadership has evolved from power utilities (1998), telecommunications firms KT and SK Telecom (1999), to Samsung Electronics (since 1999).

In KOSDAQ markets, semiconductor equipment manufacturers are gaining prominence, with Joo Sung Engineering ranking fifth, followed by semiconductor-related companies Woni IPS and Lino Engineering at seventh and eighth positions respectively.

SK Hynix submitted ADR registration documents to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in March 2026. A successful listing would enhance accessibility for overseas investors and potentially enable inclusion in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index.
main.keep_reason: 한국 1차 매체 보도: SK하이닉스가 25년 만에 삼성전자를 제치고 KOSPI 시총 1위 등극 — HBM 집중 + AI 반도체 패러다임 전환을 상징하는 한국 반도체 시장 핵심 사건.
main.select_reason: 월요일 아침 임원 회의의 첫 화제 — 25년 만의 한국 증시 시총 1위 교체, HBM·AI 반도체 패러다임 전환의 상징적 사건. Hard facts (시총 208.04조 vs 206.66조, YTD 348%), 1차 시장 데이터, MangoBoost 한국 직원 주목도 최상.

main.title: Microsoft plans 2GW data center campus in Pecos, Texas
main.body:
Microsoft has unveiled a 2GW data center campus in Pecos, Texas, partnering with oil and gas company Chevron to supply up to 2.67GW of power through a 20-year Power Purchase Agreement. The 'multibillion-dollar' project, known as Project Kilby and developed jointly by Chevron and hedge fund Engine No. 1, will span five to seven years of investment and generate approximately 6,000 construction jobs.

The power plant will primarily utilize GE Vernova-manufactured natural gas turbines alongside Caterpillar's Solar Turbines division. First power delivery is expected in 2028.

'AI is reshaping the global economy, and abundant, affordable, reliable energy is essential' to fueling that transformation, stated Jeff Gustavson, Chevron's New Energies president. Microsoft's Noelle Walsh emphasized that 'rapid growth we're experiencing in AI and cloud...requires energy infrastructure that can scale quickly and reliably.'

Chevron projects over $10 billion in state and local tax revenue while planning to use non-potable, brackish groundwater for operations and exploring water reuse from oil and gas production.

The Pecos location in West Texas represents Microsoft's expanding Texas footprint, following recent projects in Medina, Castroville, and a 700MW capacity lease at Crusoe's Abilene facility.
main.keep_reason: AI 데이터센터 전력 인프라 메가 프로젝트: Microsoft-Chevron 20년 PPA, 2.67GW 천연가스, 5-7년 투자 — DCD 1차 인프라 매체의 상세 보도 (세수/일자리/공급 일정 포함).
main.select_reason: AI 데이터센터 전력 인프라 메가 시그널 — Microsoft-Chevron 20년 PPA, 2.67GW 천연가스, 100억 달러+ 세수, 6,000명 건설직, 2028년 첫 전력. 하이퍼스케일러 인프라 결정이 화석연료 PPA로 회귀하는 흐름은 DPU/SmartNIC 수요와 직결되는 메가 트렌드.

main.title: SpaceX inks compute deal with Reflection AI, an open source AI lab
main.body:
SpaceX has signed a compute infrastructure deal with Reflection AI, an open-source AI startup. Beginning July 1, 2026, Reflection will pay $150 million monthly through 2029 for access to Nvidia's GB300 AI chips at SpaceX's Colossus 2 data center near Memphis, Tennessee. The contract is valued at $6.3 billion with a 90-day cancellation clause after the initial three months.

This agreement follows larger deals SpaceX signed with Anthropic ($1.25 billion monthly) and Google ($920 million monthly), both running through July 2029.

Reflection, founded in 2024 by former Google DeepMind researchers, emphasized that 'open source is crucial to the AI ecosystem' following the U.S. government's recent ban on Anthropic's closed models. The startup positions its open-weight approach as an alternative to proprietary frontier labs.

The Colossus data center was originally built by xAI (now part of SpaceX) for internal AI development. As xAI's operations have diminished, SpaceX has monetized its substantial AI chip inventory by leasing computing resources to major AI companies and research organizations.
main.keep_reason: AI 컴퓨트 수요 시그널: Reflection AI가 Colossus 2에서 GB300 사용에 월 1.5억 달러, 총 63억 달러 (3년) — Anthropic·Google에 이어 SpaceX의 neocloud 임대 경제 확장, GPU 인프라 수급의 가격 신호.
main.select_reason: SpaceX neocloud 임대 모델 확장 (Anthropic 월 12.5억, Google 월 9.2억에 이어 Reflection 월 1.5억) — GB300 인프라 수급의 가격 시그널. xAI 자산이 통합된 Colossus 2가 외부 임대 매출원으로 전환되는 구조적 신호.

main.title: AI chipmaker Groq confirms $650M raise, re-staffs after Nvidia's $20B not-acqui-hire deal
main.body:
AI chipmaker Groq has confirmed a $650 million funding round, roughly six months after Nvidia executed what's termed a 'not-acqui-hire' deal. That December agreement involved Nvidia licensing Groq's technology while recruiting founder Jonathan Ross, president Sunny Madra, and other key personnel.

The funding round was led by Disruptive, a Dallas-based investment firm whose founder Alex Davis chairs Groq's board, and Infinitium, a Fort Lauderdale hedge fund. Groq's valuation was not disclosed; it was previously valued at $6.9 billion following a September 2025 funding round.

Ross, who previously developed Google's Tensor Processing Unit, co-founded Groq a decade ago with fellow Google engineer Doug Wightman. Following Ross's departure to Nvidia, Wightman assumed the CEO position.

Groq's original focus centered on language processing units for inference applications, distributed through cloud services or on-premises hardware. After Nvidia obtained the LPU intellectual property, the GPU manufacturer unveiled its own inference system, the Nvidia Groq 3 LPX.

In response, Groq has pivoted toward its 'neocloud business,' which evolved from Groq's 2024 acquisition of Definitive Intelligence, previously operated by Madra. This infrastructure now spans thirteen data centers across multiple continents and serves over five million developers, processing trillions of tokens weekly.

The company has also recruited replacement executives, including Alan Rice as Chief Operating Officer (formerly at xAI and Meta), Sinclair Schuller as Chief Technology Officer, and Rakesh Malhotra as Chief Product Officer. Schuller and Malhotra previously co-founded Nuvalence, acquired by EY in 2024.
main.keep_reason: Tier 2 인접 AI 추론 칩 경쟁사: 6.5억 달러 펀딩, NVIDIA의 LPU IP 인수 이후 neocloud 비즈니스로 피벗 (13개 데이터센터, 주간 trillion 토큰 처리) — 경쟁사 전략 재편.
main.select_reason: AI 추론 칩 경쟁사의 전략 재편 — NVIDIA가 LPU IP·창립자를 가져간 뒤 Groq가 neocloud(13개 DC, 주간 조 단위 토큰)로 피벗. AI 추론 인프라 시장의 칩 vs neocloud 운영 모델 분기점을 보여주는 사례.

main.title: Nvidia wants to cut data center water use, but that's not the same as fixing AI's water problem
main.body:
Nvidia announced a warm-water cooling system designed to dramatically reduce on-site water consumption at data centers. The company claims it can eliminate 'pretty much all water usage' inside facilities through a closed-loop coolant system that recirculates without requiring fresh water replenishment.

However, the solution addresses only a partial aspect of AI's water footprint. While Nvidia's technology effectively reduces cooling water needs within data center walls, it ignores the substantial water demands upstream—particularly in electricity generation and chip manufacturing, which can double or triple total water consumption.

The technical approach pumps coolant at 45°C through server racks, extracting heat efficiently enough that passive radiators in most climates can dissipate warmth without evaporative cooling systems. This improves operational efficiency and reduces noise alongside water savings.

The critical limitation centers on power sourcing. Fossil fuel plants consumed 2.7 billion gallons daily in the U.S., with natural gas plants requiring 1.17 liters per kilowatt-hour generated. Coal plants demand even more at 2.2 liters per kilowatt-hour. The IEA projects fossil fuels will provide over 40% of new data center electricity through 2030.

Renewables like wind and solar use minimal water—approximately 0.01 and 0.03 liters per kilowatt-hour respectively. Until data centers transition away from fossil fuel dependency, water consumption challenges persist despite hardware innovations.
main.keep_reason: NVIDIA 데이터센터 냉각 신기술 (45도 warm-water closed-loop) + AI 물 발자국 한계 분석 — DPU 인접 경쟁사 + 데이터센터 효율/냉각 challenge.
main.select_reason: NVIDIA의 45°C warm-water closed-loop 냉각 시스템 — 데이터센터 내 물 사용 거의 제거. 다만 발전·칩 제조 단계의 물 발자국은 미해결, AI 인프라 지속가능성 정책 논의에 직접 영향.

main.title: Prometheus Hyperscale secures planning approval for gigawatt data center campus in Wyoming
main.body:
US data center firm Prometheus Hyperscale has secured planning approval for its long-planned Wyoming campus. The company received unanimous conditional use permit approval from the Uinta County board of commissioners for its flagship data center campus near Evanston.

The 506-acre site will initially offer 1.25GW capacity, with potential expansion to 5GW. Construction is anticipated to begin within six months of final permitting, with full buildout expected over 48 to 60 months in phases.

'This unanimous approval reflects the strength of the project's fundamentals and the depth of community engagement,' stated Trevor Neilson, Prometheus Hyperscale's president.

The company, formerly known as Wyoming Hyperscale Whitebox and relaunched in September 2024, originally planned a 120MW campus on the site in 2020. The Evanston campus will operate as a fully islanded microgrid, generating power on-site through natural gas engines and turbines rather than connecting to the public utility grid.

Prometheus is also developing additional projects including the 1.25GW Falls Ranch near Casper in partnership with Casper Carbon Capture, and a Dallas, Texas site with Engie.

In-Q-Tel, a venture firm funded by the US Central Intelligence Agency, has invested in the company.
main.keep_reason: 기가와트 데이터센터 허가 승인 (1.25GW→5GW 확장), 공공 grid 없이 자체 microgrid (천연가스), In-Q-Tel(CIA) 투자 — AI 인프라 grid bypass 모델 + 안보 함의.
main.select_reason: 1.25GW→최대 5GW grid-bypass microgrid 모델 + In-Q-Tel(CIA 투자) 안보 함의 — Microsoft Pecos와는 distinct한 '완전 islanded' 인프라 사례, AI 데이터센터 전력 조달의 또 다른 표준화 방향.

main.title: This is the Storage of Spaceborne Computer 4 Bringing AI Compute to the Moon
main.body:
HPE's Spaceborne Computer 4 represents a significant shift in space-based computing infrastructure. Unlike its predecessors (versions 1-3) deployed to the International Space Station, this fourth iteration is 'smaller and will go further,' heading to the lunar surface via the Astrolab FLEX platform.

The system addresses a critical challenge for distant missions: communication latency. By incorporating local CPU and GPU processing capabilities, the device enables autonomous decision-making on rovers without waiting for Earth-based instructions. Weight constraints demanded a compact design.

Most remarkably, the storage solution defies expectations. Rather than custom space-qualified hardware, engineers selected a Kioxia BG-series M.2 SSD—a 'low-cost' DRAM-less drive typically found in consumer systems. This pragmatic choice reflects years of proven performance; Kioxia has successfully operated commercial NAND drives in space, establishing that standard consumer-grade storage survives the environment adequately.

The system employs passive radiative cooling rather than traditional fans, essential for the lunar environment where air circulation is impossible. Launch is anticipated later in 2026.
main.keep_reason: Kioxia BG-시리즈 DRAM-less M.2 SSD를 달 표면 AI 컴퓨트에 채택 — 엣지 AI 추론, 패시브 방열 냉각, consumer-grade SSD의 우주 적용성 검증.
main.select_reason: 엣지 AI 추론을 달 표면까지 확장 — HPE Spaceborne 4가 Kioxia consumer-grade BG SSD를 채택, 패시브 방열만으로 작동. AI 인프라가 통신 지연 환경(달·심우주)에서 자율 의사결정으로 분산되는 사례. 카테고리 분산(products) 확보.
